decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly play disruptive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Broadside Bombardiers, while using mana acceleration with cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's mana base with Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while dealing direct damage with cards like Pyrogoyf, Fury, and Sundering Eruption. Additionally, support cards like Vexing Bauble and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide card advantage and disruption. This deck is designed to be aggressive and take control of the game early on.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining tempo with efficient creatures and spells. The key strategy involves using cards like Wasteland and Daze to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize take out key threats. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can quickly close out the game, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and pressure the opponent to win quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to combo off using a variety of spells to enable a quick win condition. By utilizing cards such as Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly generate mana to cast key combo pieces like Balustrade Spy and Thassa's Oracle. By milling the deck with Undercity Informer and Poxwalkers, the deck sets up for a win with either Thassa's Oracle's ability or Dread Return. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy to protect its combo.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats while controlling the board with counterspells and removal, ultimately leading to a swift victory through the power of graveyard recursion.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and playing large Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to utilize mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi such as Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End early in the game. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt the opponent's spells, while cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional pressure and control on the battlefield. The deck aims to close out the game quickly with its large, threatening creatures.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly dropping powerful Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void. It aims to take control of the game through aggressive plays and powerful creature abilities, while also utilizing cards like Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck's high mana curve and strong creatures allow it to dominate the board and overpower opponents in the early game.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient creature removal, disruption, and card advantage to control the board while applying pressure with cheap threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. The deck also utilizes countermagic like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes powerful card filtering options in Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck has a flexible game plan that can adapt to different matchups and playstyles.

The deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play early using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to ensure these big threats can hit the battlefield safely. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its fast and explosive plays, leveraging the combo synergy between its key cards to win the game quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures and use cards like Metallic Mimic and Steel Overseer to power them up. The deck also has a strong recursion plan with Scrapwork Mutt and Arcbound Ravager, as well as a way to search for key pieces with Once Upon a Time and Eye of Ugin. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast aggro strategy while also maintaining some control over the game with cards like Leyline of Transformation and Sphinx of Foresight.

The deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It aims to cheat these creatures into play early in the game to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the ability to put massive threats into play without paying their mana costs, the deck can seize victory in a single turn.

This deck focuses on assembling the Nomads en-Kor combo with Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw the entire library and win the game. It utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith, Brainstorm, and Ponder to find the combo pieces quickly while using cards like Force of Will and Prismatic Ending for disruption. The deck also includes powerful cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Teferi, Time Raveler for additional value and protection. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and win the game before the opponent can react.

Utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures and mana acceleration, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and disruption through cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. By assembling the Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin mana engine, the deck can cast high-impact threats like It That Heralds the End and Glaring Fleshraker ahead of schedule. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Wasteland and The One Ring provide additional disruption and utility to ensure dominance on the battlefield.

The deck revolves around using powerful combo pieces such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, and Sneak Attack to quickly overwhelm the opponent and win the game. It aims to cheat big creatures into play with Show and Tell, utilizing cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal for fast mana acceleration. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm for protection, along with card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency. It is a high-risk, high-reward strategy that can lead to explosive wins.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy powerful Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck uses acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple to cast its threats ahead of schedule, overwhelming the opponent with large, evasive creatures like It That Heralds the End. With a mix of disruption and efficient threats, this deck aims to apply pressure and end the game quickly before the opponent can mount a defense.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Mystic Forge combo using cards like Grim Monolith, Urza's Tower, and Manifold Key. By using the combo pieces efficiently, the deck aims to generate infinite mana and card advantage with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Glaring Fleshraker. The inclusion of Planar Nexus and Kozilek's Command provides additional utility and disruption, while cards like Vexing Bauble and The One Ring help to dig for combo pieces and protect the key cards in the deck. Overall, the goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful synergies.

The deck revolves around using Mystic Forge and various key cards to assemble a winning combo. By using cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Manifold Key, the player can generate infinite mana and card advantage, ultimately setting up a powerful finish with cards like The One Ring and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and unstoppable win condition.
